class.name: IfcGeographicElementType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : An IfcGeographicElementType is used to define an element specification of a geographic element (i.e. the specific product information, that is common to all occurrences of that product type).ÿGeographic element types include for different types of element that may be used to represent information within a geographical landscape external to a building. Within the world of geog
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Predefined types to define the particular type of the geographic element. There may be property set definitions available for each predefined type. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
